result.card: This PR adds a new REST endpoint at /rest/txspendingprevout/ that mirrors the gettxspendingprevout RPC. Clients querying the node via the unauthenticated HTTP REST API previously had no way to look up transactions spending specific outpoints in the mempool or txospenderindex without falling back to JSON-RPC. The endpoint supports batch queries of up to 15 outpoints and includes mempool_only and return_spending_tx query parameters. This completes REST coverage tracked under issue 33808 following the merge of PR 24539.
